# Hemingway 1

Author: Anders Norén (independent third-party theme author).
Theme: https://andersnoren.se/teman/hemingway-wordpress-theme/
Release: 2014. Bundled changelog dates version 1 to 2014-01-31; the author's
public release announcement is dated 2014-02-17.

Unmodified upstream files were retrieved on 2026-10-31 from:
https://themes.svn.wordpress.org/hemingway/1/

This is the original Hemingway, not Automattic's Hemingway Rewritten.
The WordPress.org SVN server hosts the author's distribution archive.

style.css is imported directly by demo/main.tsx. demo/style.css is a separate
GPL-2.0 adapter for the playground controls and responsive SVG preview.
No WordPress/PHP runtime is required. Theme fonts fall back to local sans-serif
fonts; no font or image resources are fetched at runtime.

License: GPL-2.0. Full text: license.txt. Original copyright notice: readme.txt.
The demo and theme are excluded from the npm package; library code remains MIT.
